name: Antigravity
description: Adds the Blink MCP server to Antigravity's MCP config (its location differs between versions, so Blink uses the file that exists; if neither does, open Agent panel > Manage MCP Servers > View raw config and paste the entry from Copy).
after: Done. Restart Antigravity if it was open. Its agent decides when to report, so if the notch stays empty, tell it once: "report your status to Blink".
